messages.content: What is the bash shortcut to jump to the start of the current line?

<action>
<reasoning>The user is asking for a standard bash readline shortcut. This is a direct factual answer that requires no tools.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>Press Ctrl+A to move the cursor to the beginning of the current line in bash. Use Ctrl+E to jump to the end of the line.</content>
</action>
